item.title: Summary
item.description:
Technical Writer with 5+ years of experience in B2B software documentation for developers.

My experience includes API specifications, tutorials, how-to guides, product and functionality documentation, flow diagrams, and glossaries. I turn complex technical information into clear, structured, task-oriented documentation that helps users understand and work with software effectively.

Before moving into technical writing, I worked in customer support and project management for software products. This gave me hands-on experience with customer requirements, onboarding, troubleshooting, and assisting with code implementation, and it helps me approach documentation from both technical and user perspectives.
